verdict.rationale: A natural-language command mode is a fair question for a CLI package manager, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only structured CLI commands and flags such as `bun add`, `bun update --interactive` and `--filter`, with no natural-language interface. The llms.txt and docs.md probes are LLM-readable documentation, an adjacent feature that is not a way to operate the product in natural language, so they earn no credit.
